question: Will Lula win the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro on Oct 25, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) officially declares Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva the winner of the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff election held on October 25, 2026, strictly after 2026-10-12T11:39:16.602Z and at or before 2026-10-25T11:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if the TSE officially declares Flávio Bolsonaro the winner of the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff election held on October 25, 2026, strictly after 2026-10-12T11:39:16.602Z and at or before 2026-10-25T11:00:00.000Z, or if the runoff does not take place as scheduled or is not contested between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro within that window.

Clarifications:
- "Winner" is determined by the candidate receiving a majority of valid votes cast in the runoff, as certified by the TSE. The runoff result is typically announced on election night (October 25, 2026, Brasília time); only an official TSE declaration counts.
